headline: Cyber Dragon
title: Cyber Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Cyber Dragon. What is it? It is a Level five LIGHT Machine with two thousand one hundred attack. What does it do? If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon it from your hand. How do you use it? Drop it when your opponent goes first and has a monster. It is in Duelist Pack: Zane Truesdale. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Free summon if they have monsters
